name: admin-app-getapp-unknown-name
description: firebase-admin getApp(name) for a name that was never initialized throws FirebaseAppError code app/no-app with a name-specific message. rowIds empty — admin-bootstrap capture; admin matrix rows land post-publish.

behavior.message: Firebase app named "does-not-exist" does not exist. Make sure you call initializeApp() before using any of the Firebase services.
